comment: The two small buttons lettered + and - are the parameters the maker never named, so both carry blank tooltips; they insert and delete a slot, Faders.cpp:236-251. A bank whose output has no cable is not computed at all, Faders.cpp:234. The whole process runs on a divider rather than every sample, Faders.cpp:1088-1090, so the outputs move in steps of that size. The glide is the knob divided by 32 as a time constant, Faders.cpp:227.
